title: Higher education needs better AI experiences, not more AI tools
summary_en: Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly embedded across higher education. As AI policies continue to evolve, faculty are gaining greater clarity and opportunity to responsibly use new tools, including AI-powered assistants, content generation tools, chatbots, and a growing number of AI-enabled applications.
title_cn: Higher education needs better AI experiences, not more AI tools

title: Beyond a keynote speaker: A strategic roadmap for AI in higher education
summary_en: The atmosphere inside the Global Connect/American Accounting Association conference at Caesar’s Palace in August 2026 was a study in contrasts. Outside, the Las Vegas sun was punishing, an environment so relentless that I joked that the swag bags should have swapped out sunblock for flame retardant.
title_cn: Beyond a keynote speaker: A strategic roadmap for AI in higher education
